title: Your Game is Better Than You Think: How to Find and Nurture the Soul of Your Game
prompt: Build a 'soul-finding' generative art toy where the player describes their game design in three words and the app generates a shifting abstract visual that morphs based on those words — mechanical words produce sharp geometric patterns, emotional words produce fluid organic shapes, genre words produce recognizable pixel forms. The player keeps tweaking words until the visual 'clicks' and reveals the irreducible core of their idea. Soft watercolor generative style.
